column3: Si continúas aplazando y aplazando, llegará un punto en que todo el mundo perderá el interés.
column4: If you keep on putting it off and putting it off, there'll come a point when everyone loses interest.

column3: No quiero desanimarte a comprar ese modelo si es el que quieres, pero he oído algunas cosas negativas sobre él.
column4: I don't want to put you off buying that model if that's the one you want, but I have heard some negative things about it.

column3: No podemos renovar su contrato si sigue desanimando a los clientes con su actitud negativa.
column4: We can't renew her contract if she keeps putting off customers with her bad attitude.

column3: Al oír a Tom hablar de los problemas que tiene para vender su piso me he desanimado respecto a poner el nuestro en el mercado.
column4: Hearing Tom talking about the problems he's having selling his flat has put me off the idea of putting ours on the market.

column4: Watching that horror movie just before dinner was a bad idea; it's put me right off my food!

column4: Can we please stop talking about your kidney operation? It's putting me off my lunch.

column4: If you knew how they make those sausages, it would probably put you off meat for life.

column3: No es justo; él siempre me desconcentra justo antes de tirar.
column4: It's not fair; he keeps on putting me off just before I take a shot.

column4: I was on a roll before I received that phone call. Now it's really put me off.

column4: That strange buzzing noise is putting me off. It sounds like a fly trapped in a spider-web.

column3: Es difícil expresar con palabras cómo me sentí cuando Casillas levantó la copa del mundo para España.
column4: It's difficult to put into words how I felt when Casillas lifted the world cup for Spain for the first time in history.

column4: The feeling you get when you bungee jump for the first time is impossible to put into words.

column4: I can't put into words what I feel for my pet lobster, Alan!

column3: Estas cosas son fáciles de decir, pero ponerlas en práctica no será tan fácil.
column4: These things are easy to say, but putting them into practice won't be quite so easy.

column3: Las buenas intenciones no significan nada a no ser que las pongas en práctica.
column4: Good intentions mean nothing unless you put them into practice.

column4: We've spent far too long thinking about this plan. I think it's time to put it into practice.

column3: Cuando Toby me habló de sus problemas, le dio otra perspectiva a todo lo que me preocupaba.

column3: Cuando uno ve cómo vive más de dos tercios de la población mundial, le da otra perspectiva a sus problemas.

column4: Where does this put me?

column4: Don't make it more difficult for me than it already is!

column4: He made it very difficult for her.

column4: Give your mother a call and put her mind at ease.

column4: You know it's alright to cry; you don't always have to put a brave face on everything.

column4: The situation's bad, but as my grandmother always used to say, "Put a brave face on!"

column4: Can you put your hand on your heart and tell me that?

column4: Don't put your brother down like that!

column4: I don't want to put you out, but I can't eat any wheat products because I'm a celiac.

column4: You're not putting me out! I live right next to the station, get in the car.

column4: Would you be put out if we didn't go?
